high_level_description: This image captures a groundbreaking ceremony for the first-ever Natrium plant, as announced by Bill Gates on his Instagram account. The post is dated 15 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. A group of seven individuals is actively participating in the groundbreaking ceremony. They are holding shovels and appear to be in the process of turning over dirt, symbolizing the start of construction. The individuals include both men and women, dressed in business attire, with one person wearing a cowboy hat, suggesting a blend of formal and regional attire.
